verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a REST API for running and managing models, reachable via curl, official Python and JavaScript libraries, and cloud API keys, so the core run/manage functionality is programmatic. Nothing in the evidence states or shows that the API matches everything the desktop UI does; UI-only flows such as connecting Apps on macOS have no API equivalent in the pack, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: explicit documentation of API/UI feature parity, API coverage of desktop-app features such as app connections and image generation, a published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
Python library and JavaScript library — use Ollama from your application.
Call cloud models with an API key. No Ollama installation required.
